an5.28:1.1: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammā samādhissa bhāvanaṃ desissāmi.
an5.28:1.2: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī’ti.
an5.28:1.3: evaṃ bhanteti’ti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an5.28:2.1: katamā ca bhikkhave ariyassa pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa bhāvanā? (1)
an5.28:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi (savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ) paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:2.3: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:2.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dakkho nahāpako vā nahāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nahāniyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sāyaṃ nahāniyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca paggharati.
an5.28:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati.
an5.28:2.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
an5.28:2.7: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammā samādhissa ayaṃ paṭhamā bhāvanā. (2)
an5.28:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… (samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ) dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:3.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati.
an5.28:3.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:3.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhidodako, tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammā dhāraṃ nānuppaveccheyya,
an5.28:3.5: atha kho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa.
an5.28:3.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imeva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati.
an5.28:3.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:3.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ dutiyā bhāvanā. (3)
an5.28:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… (sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti …pe…) tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:4.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati.
an5.28:4.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena apphuṭaṃ hoti. -
an5.28:4.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni anto nimuggaposīni,
an5.28:4.5: tāni yāvaggā yāva mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni.
an5.28:4.6: nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa.
an5.28:4.7: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati.
an5.28:4.8: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:4.9: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ tatiyā bhāvanā. (4)
an5.28:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pāhāṇā …pe… (upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ) catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.28:5.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti.
an5.28:5.3: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:5.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa,
an5.28:5.5: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa.
an5.28:5.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti.
an5.28:5.7: nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
an5.28:5.8: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ catutthā bhāvanā. (5)
an5.28:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahītaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ, suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
an5.28:6.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave añño vā aññaṃ paccavekkheyya, ṭhito vā nisinnaṃ paccavekkheyya, nisinno vā nipannaṃ paccavekkheyya,
an5.28:6.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahītaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ, suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāyā’ti.
an5.28:6.4: ariyassa bhikkhave pañcaṅgikassa sammāsamādhissa ayaṃ pañcamī bhāvanā
an5.28:7.1: evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariye pañcaṅgike sammā samādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo,
an5.28:8.2: tamenaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakanti?
an5.28:8.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammā samādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave same bhūmibhāge pokkharaṇī caturassā ālibaddhā pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā,
an5.28:9.2: tamenaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āliṃ muñceyya, āgaccheyya udakanti?.
an5.28:9.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammāsamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:10.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo,
an5.28:10.2: tamenaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyapi paccāsāreyyapi.
an5.28:10.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ bhāvite ariye pañcaṅgike sammā samādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate yassa yassa abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññā sacchikiriyāya,
an5.28:10.4: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:11.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ: ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya”nti,
an5.28:11.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:12.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya …pe… atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ dibbe ca mānusake ca ye dūre santike cā”ti,
an5.28:12.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:13.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ.
an5.28:13.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ
an5.28:13.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyya”nti
an5.28:13.18: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:14.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ- seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya”nti
an5.28:14.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:15.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathā kammūpage satte pajāneyya”nti
an5.28:15.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
an5.28:16.1: so sace ākaṅkhati: “āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareya”nti
an5.28:16.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyataneti.
